analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for 3 consecutive sessions. RSI has entered oversold territory (33.2), but MACD histogram is worsening (-11119.5018) in a bearish convergence. A 0.35% rebound after significant drops of -10.44% and -9.46% in the last 5 days is a weak recovery signal, with the 20-day low (1,089,000 KRW) potentially acting as the next support.
